arStrings.szText:
(PH) {c_label}{u}Ultimate Gorilla{/u}{/c} 
{icon:bullet,1.2} When you activate {c_important}Invoke{/c}, the Gorilla protects an area for {c_number}{SF_0}{/c} seconds, continuously smashing surrounding enemies for {c_number}{payload:FOREST_SMASH}{/c} Physical damage and sending out waves that deal {c_number}[100|%|]{/c} of your Thorns damage. Within the protected area you have {c_number}100%{/c} Block Chance and Block Damage Reduction.
{c_important}The Protector's{/c} strikes deal {c_number}[{SF_9}*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage and all enemies within its area deal {c_number}[{SF_8}*100|%|]{/c} reduced damage.

{c_important}The Protector's{/c} area lasts {c_number}{SF_0}{/c} more seconds and Slows enemies and Small Missiles by {c_number}[{SF_10}*100|%|]{/c}. While it's Nearby, you are {c_important}{u}Unstoppable{/u}{/c} and deal {c_number}[{SF_23}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage.
